"anim" : "fadedrop", "dur" : 300 }, "items" : "voidanim" } } } Great Wines of Italy Asia 2018 Friday, December 14, 2018
The year's Great Wines of Italy Asia tastings were a phenomenal success. They took place from December 2-9 across four different cities. Thousands of wine lovers and representatives from the wine trade packed the various venues in Beijing (Rosewood Hotel), Hong Kong (Four Seasons), Bangkok (Grand Hyatt) and Phuket (The Nai Harn). 150 Italian wineries poured some of their best wines released this year, from excellent 2014 Barolos to amazing 2013 Brunellos and great award-winning 2015 Super Tuscans.
Read our full recap here , and enjoy the video highlights from all the events above!
